title: Rollers hero
description: A full-window video hero: white two-line headline and a lede at the bottom-left over a charcoal fade, a play button in the middle that fades out and shrinks to 80% over the first few hundred pixels of scroll, and on wide screens a photo card with a charcoal pill and an orange button in the bottom-right corner plus a looping vertical scroll cue on the right edge.
notes: sized by the window minus the 64px sticky header (100svh − 4rem)
media and cardMedia are placeholders until you pass a
uses the theme's dark palette for its text so it stays white over the media in both modes
the play button's fade is a CSS scroll timeline on the page scroll
name: rollers-hero
